tools.name: get_province_availability
tools.description: Report how many appointments have appeared in one province over the last 7 and 30 days, when the last one appeared, and which procedures they were for.

province.description: Province slug, as returned by search_catalogue or list_provinces.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: List every appointment procedure at least one available office offers, with its slug and category.

tools.name: list_provinces
tools.description: List every Spanish province Cita Ping covers, with its slug and autonomous community.

tools.name: open_monitor_checkout
tools.description: Open the Cita Ping checkout with a province and procedure already chosen, so the visitor can set up alerts for it. Navigates the page; it neither submits the form nor pays. A procedure that province does not offer opens the checkout at its own picker, with the province chosen.

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Find the provinces and procedures Cita Ping covers that match a free-text query, and return their slugs. Use it to turn what someone typed into the slugs the other tools take.

query.description: What to look for, in any of the four site languages — a procedure, a province, or part of either.
